output.reason: A diabetic patient with a 4-day-old plantar cut now surrounded by redness, swelling and tenderness needs hands-on wound inspection, depth/probing assessment and possible antibiotic treatment today, which messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: Please be seen in person today — urgent care, your diabetes/foot clinic, or an emergency department if nothing else is open. In diabetes, a foot cut with spreading redness, swelling and tenderness can become a deeper infection quickly and needs the wound examined and treated in person. Keep weight off that foot. Go straight to emergency care if you develop fever, chills, fast-spreading redness, black skin, bad smell, or drainage.
differential: Cellulitis/soft-tissue infection of a diabetic foot wound
Deeper wound infection or abscess involving underlying tissue
